source_evidence: Preserve immediately preceding dialogue, exact player 'Is ther a clue of where that is?' Mara confirms previously established west-northwest ancestral-seat approach bearing, Rhevan knows general direction but never traveled there personally, landscape changed during Convergence; Cirren suggests optional comparison with western customs tower records. No exact location/distance/route or new quest. Exact current player 'Hessa, how much of this bridge and the business surrounding it do you know?' asks Hessa's own experience and commercial/local knowledge. Hessa says family operated ferry three generations, grew up helping father; knows actual local stream/banks, travelers, farmers, shepherds, pack merchants, occasional small herds, customary crossing demand and seasonal conditions; existing small ferry cannot accommodate loaded wagons, not main commercial shipping. Bridge was already ruined before grandfather's time; no personal pre-collapse knowledge, structural engineering expertise or reconstruction cost. She can describe local suppliers/customers, actual ferry receipts and expenses if invited to review her household accounts, and suggests potential ordinary shelter, animal feed, refreshments and pack-animal facilities as opportunities, not booked demand, quoted cost or proven business model. She does not offer to surrender dwelling, landing, independent ferry business, return-channel rights, accept employment, become V's steward, or grant toll monopoly; no accounting figures invented. All statements ordinary firsthand knowledge or clearly speculative opinions. No check, expense, transaction, travel, rest or new commitments. V next choice at surface. Approx Day331 18:57.
